name: Taylor Giles

bio.statement: The City of Sherwood council page lists Taylor Giles as Councilor, with a term expiring January 2027.
His city bio says he served two years on the Sherwood Planning Commission.
bio.excerpt: Then he served for 2 years on the Sherwood Planning Commission to help plan Sherwood’s responsible growth.

bio.statement: His city bio says he and a partner created the Voices for the Performing Arts Foundation.
bio.excerpt: they created the Voices for the Performing Arts Foundation (VPA)

bio.statement: The city's council page says Giles worked as a Product Manager and then Product Executive focused on improving access to healthcare.
bio.excerpt: As a Product Manager and then Product Executive, Taylor has worked to improve access to healthcare for most of his career.

source.publisher: City of Sherwood, Council Members page
